# rate-limit-planner

> Plan safe request concurrency and pacing for LLM providers from their RPM and TPM limits, average token use and latency Python package `trysac-rate-limit-planner`, import name `rate_limit_planner`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
